question: Do causal forecast and fixed suggestion gates reduce path-integrated dose relative to a latest-delivered-sample snapshot on new FDS-generated fields?
evidence_scope: New numerical cases separate from SafeStep input; not independent physical experiments or validated real buildings.

matrix.randomization: Python Random(seed).shuffle over lexicographic product; frozen CSV is authoritative; no effect-based ordering
matrix.replication: One nominal solver realization per case. Starts, departures, observation variants, and mesh checks are nested diagnostics, not new independent physical cases.

geometry_design_assumptions.layout_specification: UNION_OF_OPEN_RECTANGLES_WITHIN_RECTANGULAR_DOMAIN; remaining floor footprint is solid; wall construction and boundary representation pending FDS input freeze

L1.name: straight_corridor_with_three_rooms
L1.room_corridor_aperture_rule: Open-rectangle union gives full open room interfaces. A later door-wall refinement is a protocol amendment, not implicit here.

geometry_design_assumptions.source_status: All new geometry, apertures and ambient values here are investigator-selected modeling assumptions, not measured building parameters.

fire_design_assumptions.curve: Q(t)=min(1000,1000*(t/time_to_peak)^2) kW, held at prescribed peak thereafter; actual oxygen-limited HRR must be checked separately
fire_design_assumptions.V0: Both egress apertures open throughout; extra room window closed throughout
fire_design_assumptions.V1: Both egress apertures open throughout; extra room window open from ignition
fire_design_assumptions.source_status: HRR design targets are fixed investigator choices; unresolved chemistry and walls must not be silently borrowed from SafeStep.

sampling_and_paths.output_statistics: instantaneous; exact solver keyword must be pinned to the installed version
sampling_and_paths.neighbor_rule: four-neighbor movement plus connectors to absorbing boundary exits; graph edges may not cross solid cells
sampling_and_paths.lag15_delivery_rule: acquisition_time+15<=decision_time; never interpolate from not-yet-delivered endpoints
sampling_and_paths.predeparture_dose: excluded, as in the previous path model
sampling_and_paths.exit_termination: first arrival at absorbing exit; no modeled exit dwell dose
sampling_and_paths.failure_handling: No exit by 240 moves is a failure. Compare arrival/failure first, then dose on jointly reached cases; never reward a failed route for low partial dose.
sampling_and_paths.primary_dose_lock_required: Lock one published gas-rate formula, units, respiration/activity assumptions, included species, time base, code version, and independent hand-checks before any policy scoring. Static-device cumulative FED must not be summed along a moving route.
sampling_and_paths.incapacitation_threshold_rule: not implemented; reaching an exit does not imply tenability or safety

method_set_frozen.forecast_rules: Same anchored OLS windows/gains, nonnegative clipping, and 60 s capped extrapolation as the frozen 2026-10-18 method; only new graph and path step time differ.
method_set_frozen.execution: Apply only the first action and replan with the remaining 240-k move horizon.
method_set_frozen.fairness: Online planners receive the same delivered fields, map and movement rules; nearest-exit intentionally uses only distances; gate computation is greater and runtime is reported separately; oracle has future information.

evaluation_precommitment.primary_summary: Within each FDS case and observation condition, R_s=sum(F_snapshot-F_method)/sum(F_snapshot) on jointly reached start/departure pairs; primary R_macro is the equal-case mean of R_s. Report clean and lag15 separately. A case with summed snapshot dose<1e-8 has undefined relative benefit, is disclosed with absolute differences and a missing-relative count, and prevents claiming the continuation criterion is met for all 24 cases. Also report pooled-dose relative reduction with its distinct weighting.
harm_metrics: number of routes with higher dose
95th percentile of paired absolute dose increase
evaluation_precommitment.independence: No route-level independent-sample significance claims; 24 deterministic nominal cases support within-design description, not a powered generalization test.
evaluation_precommitment.sample_size_reason: 24 is the factorial coverage budget. It is not a power calculation or a guarantee of sufficient independent fire replication.

descriptive_continuation_criteria.purpose: Engineering screening targets, not a validated safety margin or statistical rejection rule
descriptive_continuation_criteria.new_failure_definition: Snapshot reaches the exit but the proposed method fails on the same case, observation, departure and start pair.
descriptive_continuation_criteria.layout_criterion: For each observation condition, mean of R_s over the 12 cases in each layout must be >=0; all case relative values must be defined.
descriptive_continuation_criteria.near_zero_baseline_rule: If snapshot dose<1e-8, omit route percentage and report absolute difference; all absolute harms remain in the report.
descriptive_continuation_criteria.next_action_if_pass: Seek a new independent confirmation source before proposing LLM or training; passing this design is not final confirmation.
descriptive_continuation_criteria.next_action_if_fail: Report as failed or inconclusive extension; do not search thresholds on this matrix.

execution_gates.requirement: Pin solver executable version/hash, matching manual and a bounded startup check
Freeze fuel, species yields, wall parameters and provenance; label assumptions
Render and inspect geometry/graph/vents, connectivity and sensor placement
Lock gas-to-rate conversion and verify units, time base and known concentration examples
Prespecified mesh/output sensitivity, actual HRR and relevant official validation case applicability checks
Record bounded pilot wall time/memory; freeze executable inputs before scoring methods

mesh_plan.comparison: Compare native species/temperature curves and fixed diagnostic-route doses, not method effect rankings. Record actual discretized apertures and burner area at every mesh. Exit height 2.0 m is aligned on all three candidate grids; wall and window realization still needs checking. No claim that D*/dx alone validates the mesh.
mesh_plan.target_status: Investigator screening choice; near-zero comparisons use absolute values; acceptance must include physically relevant variable review.
mesh_plan.if_unresolved: Stop before method evaluation, amend physics protocol with explanation, preserve failed outputs.

review_amendment.timing: Before any new FDS run or policy scoring
changes: Require zero new paired failures, rather than only nonincreasing total failures
Define per-layout non-worsening by the equal-case mean relative benefit
Correct L2 description: the touching south rectangles form a continuous open band
Change exit height from 2.25 to 2.0 m to align the aperture on all three candidate mesh spacings

scope_controls.on_parameter_change: New protocol version and hashes, with reason and timing; never retroactively call a viewed scenario unseen.

official_sources_checked.supports: FDS scope as smoke and heat flow simulation; not evidence of validation for our new geometry
Official manual entry points; version must match executable before implementation
Official validation cases, experimental and solver-output repositories are distinct
Fixed-version manual: Mesh Resolution; Time-Dependent Functions; Device Output; FED/FIC; gas quantity definitions. Exact local executable still pending.
Candidate known-input verification fixture only, not universal fuel-yield evidence
Candidate species/FED verification fixture; no execution claimed
